title: Kolibri 1 Q4_K_M GGUF on llama.cpp (bartowski)
slug_note: Aleph Alpha's 78B MoE (3.46B active) as a 49.8 GB GGUF; one llama-server command.

variation.quant_detail: Q4_K_M, 49.76 GB (per-tensor layout; needs llama.cpp b11716 or newer)

requirements.notes: Estimate: the 49.8 GB file plus KV cache at a modest context. Not measured.

steps.text: Install llama.cpp b11716 or newer (see Step 0 in Quick start).

caveats: No speed or memory numbers recorded yet.
Aleph Alpha's official weights are FP8 (~78 GB) for data-centre GPUs; this is bartowski's community GGUF.
The card recommends 262K context or less for serving; 1M is by extrapolation.
